jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: First Night
jokes.joke: I was so nervous my first night waiting tables that when a customer said, “We’re ready to order,” I said, “That makes one of us.” Then he asked what I recommended. I said, “A different waiter. I’ve seen him work.”

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Ex-Girlfriend.exe
jokes.joke: My ex still haunts me. Not like a ghost — like a server. Three years later I'll get a notification at 2 AM: 'Memory from this day.' We're not even friends. I didn't ask for this. It's like she's running a background process on my emotional operating system, and I never agreed to the terms of service. I just wanted to log off. Instead I'm getting push notifications from a relationship that's been uninstalled for years.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Ghostly Downtime
jokes.joke: I always thought the scariest part of becoming a ghost would be the actual haunting. But honestly, it’s being unprepared for the sheer amount of downtime. You spend centuries waiting in a dusty attic for a new family to move in, and you don’t even have a smartphone to scroll through. I'm just floating up there practicing my scary noises in a mirror for two hundred years.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Island Red Alert
jokes.joke: I booked a last-minute trip to a tropical island and showed up completely unprepared. Three pairs of wool socks, zero sunscreen, one blazer. By day two I was so red the kids on the beach kept circling me with sticks, trying to roast marshmallows off my shoulders.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Island Ghosted
jokes.joke: I tried to take a vacation on a tropical island, but the place felt straight-up haunted. Every time I tried to relax, something creaked behind me. I wasn’t scared—I was just annoyed. I came for palm trees and cocktails, not a ghost whispering, “Boo.” I told it, “Buddy, I paid extra for oceanfront, not paranormal beachfront.”

scores.comment: Relatable digital-haunting premise, but the tech metaphors pile up and the final line mostly reiterates the same idea rather than escalating it.
Clear ghost perspective and usable premise, but the downtime angle develops into mild whimsy rather than a strong punchline.
Concrete setup, efficient escalation, and a clean visual payoff. The sunburn-as-heat-source gag is familiar, but it lands.
Cleanly uses both concepts, but the haunting material is generic and 'paranormal beachfront' is more wordplay than a strong final turn.
Clean self-deprecating waiter bit; 'I've seen him work' is the strongest line here, tight and stage-ready.
Nice reframe of haunting-as-boredom, but the closing image is soft and the bit rambles instead of snapping.
Sunburn/marshmallow image is vivid and escalates well; solid economy, punchline lands cleanly.
Wordplay payoff ('paranormal beachfront') is the highlight; setup is a bit generic but the turn earns it.
Clean stand-up rhythm and natural dialogue. The misdirection on the recommendation lands a solid mild laugh, though the waiter anxiety premise is somewhat familiar.
The tech metaphor is overly explanatory and reads more like a monologue essay than tight stand-up. It over-explains the premise instead of landing a hard punchline.
Strong visual image in the punchline with a sharp escalation from the sunburn setup. Good stage rhythm and natural first-person delivery.
Conceptually weak turn that relies on flat dialogue restating the premise. The final line lacks a strong comic twist to carry a real laugh.
Clean nervous-server setup with a serviceable double turn; familiar waiter territory kept tight.
Extended tech-metaphor pile-on that stays clever rather than funny; rhythm sags under the list.
Fresh downtime angle on ghost life; solid premise and clean close without overreaching.
Generic haunted-vacation complaint; punchline restates the setup with little snap.
Clean first-person waiter nerves; solid timing, mild but real laugh.
Strong metaphor but long and prose-like; punchline softens.
Clear premise, gentle humor; lacks a sharper turn or final snap.
Straightforward but effective; good escalation and a clean final image.
